newsitem.title: SPAIN: Thirteen Britons arrested in Spain drug crackdown.
newsitem.headline: Thirteen Britons arrested in Spain drug crackdown.

text.p: Spanish authorities have arrested 13 Britons and seized over 1,000 kilos (2,200 lbs) of hashish in a crackdown on a ring smuggling drugs between Spain and Britain, police said on Sunday.

Four suspects, including the alleged ringleader, were seized on Friday near the Mediterranean coastal city of Alicante while transferring a shipment of drugs from a boat to a truck, Spanish officials said.
The raid led to the arrests of nine other suspects and the seizure of 6 million pesetas ($42,000) and several thousand British pounds in cash.

A joint investigation by Spanish drug enforcement agents and customs officers began eight months ago when officials learned that a known British drug smuggler was living near Alicante, authorities said.
It was the latest in a series of raids in which Spanish authorities in recent weeks have arrested dozens of suspects and seized thousands of kilos of illegal drugs.
